requirements.title: Map-objective timer alerts
requirements.statement: The host shall raise non-critical map-objective alerts derived only from the GSI game clock (map.clock_time) while map.game_state is in progress and the game is not paused, using one patch-versioned timing table that names a source for every row. Each objective (water, power, bounty and wisdom rune, Tormentor first spawn) has a Settings switch, on by default, and zero to two pre-warning lead times of 5 to 60 s each; the defaults are 30 s and 15 s for water and power runes and none for the others; a spawn alert always follows while the objective is on. Roshan respawn and Tormentor respawn are reported unavailable. Each alert shows as a compact rounded card with an original objective glyph and a colour accent from the HUD's fixed dark palette (the HUD never follows the app theme), centred directly under the danger meter (RISK) with a 4 px gap by default, where it may enter the top of the protected announcement region by at most 24 px at 1080 (scaled with screen height) under the UI-015 allowance; the objective name stays in English and the sentence follows the saved app language, which the host sends with every alert (Thai examples: “Power rune จะเกิดใน 30 วินาที”, “Water rune เกิดแล้ว”; the English UI stays fully English). An event video banner may cover the card. The tone plays on the single-slot sink as soon as it is idle, within 5 s of the due time; a clip that is playing is never cut, ducked or delayed for it, and a tone not started within 5 s is dropped and logged as suppressed. Each objective plays its own original locally synthesized short soft tone (distinct pitch or pattern) at the announcer channel volume. The card's size and position follow the UI-015 layout. An opt-in local diagnostic may log only the GSI map key names and roshan_* values; the info log lines objective_alert_shown (kind, lead_s, clock, and whether the tone played, the card was covered or the tone was suppressed), objective_prefs_changed and layout_changed carry no user identity.
requirements.failure_behavior: When the clock is missing, stale, paused or not in progress, no alert fires and nothing is derived from wall or browser time. A backward or forward clock jump fires no backlog of passed alerts. When an announcer clip or critical warning is playing, the text alert still shows at its due time and the tone is not played (owner decision 2026-11-22, DEC-EVENT-RUNE-SPAWN revision 3); any game clip that starts during the tone preempts it, so the tone never stops, ducks or delays a clip or the critical cue. A timing without a sourced row in the table, or a respawn without a death signal, stays unavailable and is never shown as a time; rows not yet confirmed against official patch notes are marked so in the table. No memory reading, game input or hidden enemy information. Invalid lead times or a corrupt prefs file keep the last valid prefs (defaults if none) and are reported; they never change the honesty rules of the scheduler.

requirements.title: Orb sound mixer
requirements.statement: The orb panel shall present vertical channels in a fixed order: Game (Dota 2) first, then up to three slots the user configures in Settings, so the panel never shows more than four channels. A slot is the Kohbor announcer, the Music channel (a user-selected application, or the first running default), or another application that has a Windows audio session, chosen by executable name (for example Discord). Slot order is editable; the defaults are Kohbor and Music. Each channel shall provide a 0 to 100% level and mute, applied within 100 ms. An application with several sessions shall show their common value, or a mixed state with the range when they differ, and a change moves all of its sessions together. A configured application with no live session shall show the missing state. Focus mode shall lower every non-game application channel (Music and added applications) to an adjustable default of 20%, never raising a lower level, and restore each prior value on a second activation; the Kohbor announcer is never lowered, so Kohbor alerts stay audible (owner decision 2026-11-22). An optional user-assigned Focus hotkey is off by default. Show honest missing/unreadable session states and explain failed sets while restoring the last read level. Every control, including the slot editor, shall have a keyboard-reachable UI-006 deck twin. A fader wheel step is 5% and is active only while the panel is open. The panel shall fit one to four channels at 720p and 1080p without overflow, never cover a protected region and keep the 8 px click-through edge.
requirements.failure_behavior: Never show a missing or unreadable session as controllable, and never show one invented value for an application whose sessions differ. Refuse more than three slots, a duplicate application, Dota as a slot, or a second Kohbor or Music slot; an invalid stored setting falls back to the defaults. On set failure restore the last read value and state the reason. Preserve Dota focus and critical-alert priority.

requirements.title: Local own-match history

A match left before a winner is reported (menu, game window or process loss, or a new match) is recorded with a null result, never as a loss. Match type is taken only from an explicit, documented GSI field; GSI provides none (GSI-INTAKE-SPEC 4.2, A-9), so it is recorded as unknown. Win rates count every recorded match with a known result whose type is ranked, unranked or unknown; until match types are known this means all modes, and the rate is labelled as covering all modes. Bot, custom and lobby matches, once their type is known, are recorded but not counted; custom games are never recorded. Matches with a null result are never counted. The history is an atomic JSON file in the app data directory, bounded to the newest 500 entries, and the user can clear it from the Overview.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unverified or mismatched ownership, custom games and spectating record nothing. A corrupt or oversized file starts empty with one warning code, and a failed write keeps the previous file. An abandoned entry never replaces a completed entry for the same match. A hero win rate is computed only from 5 counted games.

acceptance.given: an owner-played Dota draft at 1920×1080 and 100% scale with an admitted session
acceptance.when: the Live page is shown during HERO_SELECTION, STRATEGY_TIME or TEAM_SHOWCASE, including unsupported geometry, capture/identification failure and match/session/app clear boundaries
acceptance.then: all ten top-bar slots show the correctly identified hero name or unknown with a reason; unsupported conditions expose their actual reason; the strip remains in-memory and control-window only with no overlay/log/disk/network sink, and data clears at match end, session change and app exit. Accuracy evidence remains NOT_RUN until an owner-played draft is observed

requirements.implementation_freedom: Keep draft pixels, hero identities and unknown reasons in the in-memory control-window path; do not add a persistence, network or overlay sink.

requirements.title: Show-app hotkey
requirements.statement: A global show-app hotkey, default Ctrl+Alt+X, shall toggle the control window. When the control window is hidden, minimized or not focused, a press shows, restores and focuses it; when it is visible and focused, a press hides it (to the tray when the tray icon exists) and returns the foreground to the window that was foreground before the show, if that window still exists. The hotkey shall be registered with the operating system hotkey registration only: no keyboard hook, no synthesized input to any process and no read of another process. It is on by default, has a Settings switch, and is remappable with registration-conflict detection and transactional replacement. Support is promised over borderless fullscreen and windowed Dota; Settings discloses that in exclusive fullscreen the game may minimize when the window comes up.
requirements.failure_behavior: If registration fails, keep the prior working binding (or none), show the error with its reason, and never silently choose another key. Reject baseline and Windows-reserved keys. Warn when an Alt-only key may take a Dota binding. Do not show the overlay, HUD or orb as a side effect; they keep their own visibility and focus rules.

acceptance.given: the hotkey enabled, Dota in borderless fullscreen or windowed mode, and the control window hidden to the tray, minimized or behind Dota
acceptance.when: the player presses the hotkey, presses it again, remaps it to a free key, remaps it to a key another program holds or to a reserved key, and disables it
acceptance.then: the first press brings the control window to the foreground and the second hides it with Dota foreground again; no synthesized input is sent and overlay or orb activation_detected stays zero; a free key replaces the old one, a held or reserved key leaves the prior binding working with a visible error, and disabling releases the key; Settings discloses the exclusive-fullscreen limit

requirements.implementation_freedom: Choose the registration thread, preference file and capture UI. Keep RegisterHotKey-only input, the toggle and focus-return behaviour, and transactional replacement.

requirements.title: Overview player dashboard and news
requirements.statement: The Overview page shall show only the player's own data and Kohbor news, in two columns, and shall always lay out every section, whatever data exists. The main column shows statistics from the local match history (MEM-006): the overall win rate with its base count and, while counted matches include unknown types, the label "All modes (ranked/unranked not yet separated)" (Thai "รวมทุกโหมด (ยังแยก ranked/unranked ไม่ได้)"); a wins/losses/no-result donut with the match count in its centre; the latest counted results as 20 win/loss slots titled with the true count, empty slots drawn as outlines; a 10-match rolling win-rate trend whose frame, axes and gridlines are always drawn and whose line appears only from 10 counted matches; two best-hero panels like Dota Plus, "best of all time" and "this month" (the local calendar month, whose start the renderer sends to the host), each with three cards showing the bundled hero icon, name, games, wins–losses, win rate and average K/D/A, ranked by win rate among heroes with at least 3 counted games (then more counted games) and filled by most played when fewer qualify; and a recent-matches table with hero, W/L or an em dash, K/D/A, duration, date and source badge. The side column shows the news feed (UPDATE-005): the pinned post first, a type filter (all, announcements, app updates, patches) and an "all news" control that expands the list in place. The page shows no readiness or GSI content, and the shell's GSI and game status chips are hidden on the Overview page only. The OpenDota history import appears only as a disabled card labelled as coming soon until its own slice.
requirements.failure_behavior: With no counted matches the rates read 0.0% over a base of 0 matches with the all-modes label, the donut is an empty grey ring with 0 in its centre, all 20 result slots are empty outlines, the trend frame shows a faint "needs at least 10 matches" note, and the table keeps its header with faint empty rows up to five; loading, unavailable and empty histories add a one-line note instead of collapsing a section. Empty best-hero slots hold a fixed set of three placeholder heroes (Pudge, Juggernaut, Crystal Maiden) with every stat at 0, 0–0, 0.0% and 0.0 K/D/A, shown desaturated with a "Placeholder" chip and the tooltip "No data yet — showing a placeholder slot"; a placeholder never repeats a real hero and never counts toward any number. A real value that is unknown shows an em dash, and a match with no result is never counted or shown as a loss. The news column shows loading, offline with the cached fetch time, unavailable, empty or switched-off states; a news failure never blanks the statistics column.

acceptance.given: an empty history and a history of about 25 matches with counted, unknown-type and no-result matches, heroes with fewer and more than 3 counted games, matches on both sides of the local month start, and news views that are loading, current, offline with cache, unavailable, empty and switched off
acceptance.when: the Overview page renders in Thai and English and the user changes the news filter and expands the news list
acceptance.then: every section is laid out in both cases; with no data the tiles read 0.0% and 0 matches with the all-modes label, the donut is an empty ring with 0, the 20 slots and the trend frame are empty, the table shows five faint empty rows and both best-hero panels show three labelled, desaturated placeholders with zero stats; with data the rates use counted matches with their base count, the donut splits wins, losses and no result, the trend line appears only from 10 counted matches, each panel ranks by win rate from 3 counted games and falls back to most played, the month panel uses only matches from the local month start, and remaining slots are placeholders; the news column shows the pinned post first and the filtered, expandable list or the matching state; the OpenDota card is disabled and labelled coming soon; and no GSI or readiness chip appears on the Overview while other pages keep them
